name: youtube-mcp-server
description: Comprehensive MCP server for the YouTube Data API v3, Analytics API, and Reporting API. Gives Claude full access to your YouTube channel: analytics, video management, comments, playlists, transcripts, SEO tools, and bulk reporting. 40 tools total.
long_description: This server covers three YouTube APIs and is the only open-source MCP server that provides the YouTube Analytics API (channel performance, audience retention, traffic sources, demographics, revenue), the YouTube Reporting API (bulk CSV report scheduling and download), and full YouTube Data API v3 coverage including video upload, playlist management, comment read/write, SEO autocomplete, trending videos, and category discovery. It also includes client-side quota tracking with hard-fail protection.
